title: Celsius to Fahrenheit conversion
scope: A deterministic repository lifecycle test for converting a numeric Celsius temperature to Fahrenheit; not for production, safety-critical, or authority-bearing use.
trigger: A request contains a numeric temperature_celsius value.
procedure: Accept a numeric input named temperature_celsius.
Return temperature_fahrenheit using the public conversion F = (C × 9/5) + 32.
Reject missing, null, string, and malformed inputs.
negative_evidence: The repository has no LRN runtime; these observations do not demonstrate ANS runtime execution.
limitations: This candidate does not establish operational correctness, authority, validation, or activation.
The public LRN schema records the contract as text and does not provide typed input/output fields.
The tests exercise the public conversion directly, not an ANS execution mechanism.
stop_conditions: Stop if the input is not a finite numeric temperature_celsius value.
Do not use this candidate outside repository lifecycle testing without human validation.
